source_evidence: Retirement share classes are typically only available through an employer-sponsored retirement plan, such as a 401(k). Mutual funds may offer more than one retirement share class with different levels of ongoing operating expenses including those with and without 12b-1 fees.
answer: Retirement share classes are mutual fund share classes typically offered through an employer-sponsored retirement plan, such as a 401(k). A fund may offer more than one retirement class, and their ongoing expenses can differ; some may include 12b-1 fees while others do not. So, retirement classes are not necessarily identical in cost—compare the expenses of the available options.
